user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 725 lux 到 1303 lux
期望 温度 处于 16 ℃ 到 23 ℃
期望 湿度 处于 35 % 到 40 %
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() < 725 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_up() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() > 1303 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_down() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() > 23 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_cool() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() < 16 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_heat() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF xiaomi_humidity_sensor.relative_humidity() < 35 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_humidifier
IF xiaomi_humidity_sensor.relative_humidity() > 40 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_air_fresh
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_television
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_diffuser
